priorityList: Charge to the target if out of range.
Maintain Rend on the target, refreshing it if it has less than 2 seconds remaining or if Colossus Smash is about to be cast.
Cast Avatar and Colossus Smash (or Warbreaker) together to align your burst windows.
Cast Ravager when Colossus Smash is ready to be used or is already active.
Cast Champion's Spear while the Colossus Smash debuff is active on the target.
Cast Demolish while Colossus Smash is active, ideally when you have 10 stacks of Colossal Might.
Cast Execute whenever Sudden Death procs or the target is within the health threshold (below 20%, or 35% with Massacre).
During Execute phase, cast Mortal Strike if you have 2 stacks of Executioner's Precision or a Battlelord proc.
Cast Mortal Strike on cooldown as your primary spender.
Cast Overpower to generate Rage and buff the damage of your next Mortal Strike.
Cast Bladestorm as a filler during Colossus Smash if your primary rotational abilities are on cooldown.
Cast Wrecking Throw as a filler in single-target situations if no other priority abilities are available.
Use Slam as a low-priority filler when you have excess Rage.
Use offensive Trinkets and Racials (like Berserking or Blood Fury) during the Avatar and Colossus Smash window.
